product_one_liner.value: Bizagi is a low-code business-orchestration and process-automation platform for enterprise business and IT users that connects people, systems, data, bots and AI to design, automate and run end-to-end processes.

pricing_page.notes: The page describes Bizagi's consumption-based pricing model.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 438 employees and the 201-500 company-size band.

eng_blog.notes: Bizagi describes its blog as covering company news, platform innovations and digital-transformation trends; the reviewed index does not establish two engineer-authored build/architecture posts.

public_docs.notes: The public Platform User Guide contains multiple product-help articles and links to community and training resources.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The accessible current posting is for a Digital Transformation Engineer; it is not titled AI, ML, machine learning, data science, applied scientist, research scientist, NLP, LLM or computer vision.

model_provider.value: Microsoft Azure OpenAI, specifically Azure Private OpenAI GPT

compliance_certs.notes: The page explicitly states ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification and separately describes HIPAA/HITECH and GDPR compliance.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round was announced in September 2017, before the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The accessible current posting is a Digital Transformation Engineer, not an SDR, BDR or Account Executive posting.

launched_6mo.notes: Bizagi's Summer 2026 release was dated 2026-07-21 and introduced new AI, integration, app-design and operational capabilities.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Juan Pablo Rincón was announced as Bizagi's VP for Latin America in June 2025 and his profile reports the role beginning in May 2025, within the requested 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Bizagi's connector documentation visibly names Salesforce, HubSpot, Dynamics 365 and FreshDesk CRM connectors.
